sentences.cn_text: 自从在流媒体领域挑战 Netflix 公司以来,传统好莱坞一直难以实现盈利,Disney+、Peacock 和 Paramount+ 等平台每年亏损数十亿美元,引发了人们对这些服务能否像有线电视曾经那样盈利的担忧。
sentences.en_text: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.

sentences.cn_text: 但流媒体时代却让一些意想不到的赢家获益:盗版者使用软件在几秒钟内从合法在线视频平台上翻录电影或电视节目,并将这些内容托管在自己的非法服务上,这些服务每年通过广告和订阅赚取约 20 亿美元。
sentences.en_text: But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.

sentences.cn_text: 据代表好莱坞制片厂并致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台的行业组织电影协会称,由于没有视频制作成本,非法流媒体网站的利润率接近 90%。
sentences.en_text: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that’s working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.

sentences.cn_text: 最初,像 Netflix 这样的合法在线业务的兴起实际上帮助遏制了主要基于文件上传的数字盗版行为。
sentences.en_text: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.

sentences.cn_text: 但现在,据美国商会全球创新政策中心估算,涉及非法流媒体服务以及文件共享的盗版行为每年给美国经济造成约 300 亿美元的收入损失和大约 25 万个就业岗位的流失。
sentences.en_text: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce’s Global Innovation Policy Center.

sentences.cn_text: 全球影响每年约为 710 亿美元。
sentences.en_text: The global impact is about $71 billion annually.

sentences.cn_text: 电影协会首席执行官查理·里夫金表示:「那些盗窃我们的电影和电视节目并运营盗版网站的人并非夫妻店式的小作坊,这是有组织的犯罪。」
sentences.en_text: “The people who are stealing our movies and our television shows and operating piracy sites are not mom and pop operations,” says Charlie Rivkin, chief executive officer of the MPA.

sentences.cn_text: 里夫金于 2017 年加入电影协会,此前该组织在五年前未能在好莱坞和硅谷之间达成共识,以推动国会通过旨在打击网络盗版的立法。
sentences.en_text: “This is organized crime.” Rivkin joined the MPA in 2017 after the organization failed five years earlier to build consensus between Hollywood and Silicon Valley to win passage of legislation in Congress aimed at stopping online piracy.

sentences.cn_text: 2017 年,该协会成立了创意与娱乐联盟,这是一个由约 100 名侦探组成的执法工作组,在全球范围内协助地方当局逮捕流媒体盗版者。
sentences.en_text: In 2017 the association formed the Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE), an enforcement task force of about 100 detectives circling the globe to help local authorities arrest streaming pirates.

sentences.cn_text: 创意与娱乐联盟表示,它已帮助将北美非法流媒体服务的数量从 2018 年的 1400 多个减少到 126 个,这部分得益于电影协会支持的一项 2020 年联邦法律,该法律将大规模传播版权材料定为严重犯罪。
sentences.en_text: ACE says it’s helped shrink the number of illegal streaming services in North America to 126, from more than 1,400 in 2018, aided in part by the MPA’s support for a 2020 federal law that made large-scale streaming of copyright material a serious crime.

sentences.cn_text: 咨询公司 Parks Associates 预测,自 2022 年以来,美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失将在未来两年内达到 1130 亿美元。
sentences.en_text: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services’ cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.

sentences.cn_text: 分析师史蒂夫·霍利表示:「尽管有些人乐观地认为,新兴的应对措施和最佳实践可能会使盗版在 2027 年前趋于平稳,但利益相关者之间对于盗版何时开始减少并未达成共识。」
sentences.en_text: “While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline,” says analyst Steve Hawley.
